summary: All four exact-hash council lanes rejected v1.8. Canonical identity and forward-only release intent are sound, but broker read/write protocols, archive schemas, publisher run binding, append-only mutation receipts, old-workflow retirement, and cross-repository platform ownership remain incomplete.
validation: Strict structure passed 24 MUSTs, 12 acceptance criteria, 12 tests, and 24 trace rows.
Both golden identity lengths, SHA-256 values, and digest-base64url values recomputed exactly.
Administrator evidence matched 4024 bytes and SHA-256 55dbee3772ce06d0af59df8cb21d6862d4d167470065e2580ff9adb3d28efb58.
Planner, security, QA, and DevOps independently returned NO-GO.
No repository, workflow, release, registry, package, or cluster mutation occurred during council review.
blockers: Define closed mint/upload/read/readback capability schemas, token claims, object keys, exact archive bytes, and ambiguity semantics.
Bind two candidate archives to separate one-object capabilities and define exact signed-authorization read/write capabilities.
Move exact publisher-run receipt creation to trusted coordinator authority and add an append-only per-mutation receipt chain.
Retire the old privileged workflow ID and remove or rotate its reusable credentials so old-tag dispatch or rerun cannot regain authority.
Bound runner-config, codicarium-actions, Vault, app wiring, DNS/TLS, network policy, runner isolation, rollout, and rollback ownership.
Separate external administrator review from repository CI; CI only proves runtime non-consumption.
Add executable 1000-suite horizon, live-evidence schema, exact tuple-base64url, job mapping, and total sequencing fixtures.
next_action: Revise to v1.9 with closed protocol/schema fixtures and explicit platform dependencies, then rerun an exact-hash planner/security/QA/DevOps council before implementation.
independent_lanes: capability protocol, archive, and isolated runner
external review, CI, and live evidence

issues.title: Artifact capability and archive contracts are incomplete
issues.details: Read/write token, object, archive, runner, and platform ownership cannot yet be implemented or tested without invention.

issues.title: Publisher run and mutation receipts are not safely bound
issues.details: A manual run can race the public claim, and one immutable pre-write receipt cannot contain later mutation outcomes.

issues.title: Immutable old workflow retains privileged execution
issues.details: Current-main guards cannot remove OIDC and reusable credentials from the v0.6.13 workflow or its reruns.

issues.title: Administrator evidence gate conflicts with CI non-consumption
issues.details: Administrator-only live validation must be manual/council evidence, while repository CI only scans for runtime non-use.
